notes: Channel aliases only. Each entry maps to a real engine/registry.json preset, camera, transition or component. Plans must write the registry name in the slot plus the params below; the alias name itself is NOT valid in animation.json.

An element has one enter ('preset'), one 'loop' and one 'exit', and they share ONE params object with the component params. Merge alias params when combining, e.g. paper_drop + paper_pluck -> {"inSec":0.28,"overshoot":0.08,"outSec":0.2}.
pop_in overshoot feeds Easing.back(overshoot*15): 0.06 ~ subtle, 0.10 ~ clear, 0.14 = channel maximum.
Camera presets ease across the whole scene and reset at the next scene.

paper_drop.use: Default enter for a newly built part or prop.

paper_slap.use: Term tags, fix counter, badges, stat callouts, READY stamp.

paper_rise.use: Walls, pipes, shelves rising from the ground line or floor.

paper_slide_left.use: Tuck or materials entering from the left.

paper_slide_right.use: Tuck or materials entering from the right.

paper_hop.use: Small props landing (cans, jugs, batteries); Tuck cheer.

problem_jolt.use: Part that fails on the 'But' word. Re-declare the part with this preset in the problem beat.

glow_on.use: Mustard glow discs, night overlays. Not for structure.

place_static.use: Carry-forward: every previously built element redeclared in later beats.

host_idle.use: Tuck idle sway (rotates around element center).

lamp_glow.use: Mustard glow disc behind a lamp.

alert_pulse.use: Signal Red problem badge while the problem is unsolved.

drift.use: Clouds, dust motes. Never on structure.

paper_pluck.use: Removing a failed part or a solved problem badge.

quiet_out.use: Glows, weather, tags at end of beat.

cam_hold.use: Default. At least half of all beats.

cam_lean_in.use: Land on a fix near frame center (named object = last word of the sentence).

cam_land.use: Finale or a target within 0.15 of center. Max 2 per video.

cam_sink.use: Attention moves down a shaft or into the bedrock.

cam_rise.use: Attention moves up to the surface or roof.

cam_slide_r.use: Attention moves right (keep the target left of x 0.84).

time_skip.use: Day to night, or a time jump ('two weeks later').

topic_turn.use: Rare: switch to an interior close-up (bag interior, comparison).

caption_paper.use: One Caption per script segment. highlightColor = fill because at 1 word per chunk the word is always 'active'.

term_tag_text.use: Named term next to its object. Pair with term_tag_back at the same x/y.

term_tag_back.use: Paper tag backing. Adjust width to text length. Shadow is FUTURE (none in engine).

stat_callout.use: Number + unit, e.g. '1 GAL/DAY'. Source every number (guardrails).

fix_counter.use: 'FIX n/N'. Re-enter with paper_slap each time n changes; otherwise place_static.

problem_specks.use: Abstract hazard (fallout, mold, leaks). Set a unique seed per element.

fix_confetti.use: Finale and READY stamp only. Unique seed.

host.use: Tuck. Set y so the feet touch the ground line (0.44) or a built floor; poses via params.poses [{atSec, asset}].
